notes.title: Follow the mobile version game
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello friends![/h1]

It's no secret that now I'm developing a mobile version of game Grass Cutter.

From this day forward, at least once a week I will be publish a report on the work done!
And gamers who completed the PC version game will be discover a lot of new things!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28130104/160d9a60fe53d52e180902f648331b357dd5f042.gif[/img]

I will gladly read all your messages and recommendations for the game.

There is a possibility that someone your ideas and recommendations will be embodied in the mobile version of game. So do not hesitate to give advice!
We are all different, everyone thinks in his own way. There's an expression: “Two heads are better than one.” The more of us there are, the better ideas. This will provide a higher quality product. Later, for a small number of people will be open access to an earlier version of the game.

Have a nice day, everyone! I love everyone!

In order to follow the development of the mobile version of game or to help the developer, you can subscribe to the official pages on social networks:

[b]Facebook:[/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/grasscuttergame] https://www.facebook.com/grasscuttergame[/url]
[b]Twitter:[/b] [url=https://twitter.com/mr_usanik] https://twitter.com/mr_usanik[/url]

[url=https://www.facebook.com/grasscuttergame][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28130104/8ce2131cb24d68206d885dbb36c7d89892002d8c.png[/img][/url] [url=https://twitter.com/mr_usanik][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28130104/dd2ab80de878fb9bb88c99834bfd06faa9f97e9a.png[/img][/url]

P.S.
[i]I'm Sorry that I rarely make publications. I am really busy, because there is still a lot of work ahead. I very want  to give you the interesting product of the highest quality.[/i]

[b] Fixed bugs: [/b]
[list]
    [*]Unattainable achievement “Strong assistant”
    [*]When the controller was changed to the keyboard, WASD was not displayed in the management interface
    [*]Purchase a lawn mower after leaving the store. [url=https://youtu.be/JRzS1d2ou60?t=7m24s] Sample of a bug[/url]
[/list]

[b] Improvements: [/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed micro freezes when moving the camera and the drone
    [*]Improved Smartgrass Behavior.
    [*]When you hit the secret level from the gameground, return to the main levels after it ends.
[/list]
